bugs.title: OTP back button trapped on OTP screen
bugs.symptom: App bar / system back navigates to login but router redirect forces user back to OTP while auth status is otpPending
bugs.rootCause: _authRedirect rewrites any non-OTP location to OTP when AuthStatus.otpPending
bugs.fix: AuthNotifier.cancelOtpPending() + PopScope on OTP screens; call before context.go(login)

bugs.title: Staff OTP back leaves stale pending state
bugs.symptom: Staff OTP back navigates to staff login but StaffLoginStatus remains otpPending
bugs.rootCause: Back handler did not reset staffLoginProvider
bugs.fix: staffLoginProvider.notifier.reset() on back + PopScope for system back

bugs.title: Teacher mobile login fails on staging API
bugs.symptom: verify-otp with scope=teacher returns MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND for seeded teacher phones
bugs.rootCause: Demo school seed / backend membership scope gap (pre-existing from v17.4 validation)
bugs.fix: Requires backend seed fix — out of client-only QA scope
bugs.workaround: Use Staff ERP portal for teacher phone until seed updated

bugs.title: Staging sends OTP for unregistered phones
bugs.symptom: Any 10-digit phone receives dev-mode OTP on /auth/login; rejection only at verify

bugs.title: iPhone device UI validation incomplete
bugs.symptom: Automated launch blocked when device locked during prior session
bugs.fix: Manual OTP walkthrough on unlocked iPhone
